narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>We must measure every side and every angle of the tile.
<bookmark mark='equal'/>In a regular hexagon all six sides are equal, and so are the angles.
<bookmark mark='waste'/>Measuring the same length six times tells us nothing new.

narration: <bookmark mark='c1'/>To check, picture the six matching triangles inside the tile.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Each needs only a base and a height, and all six share the same two.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the answer; the six triangles reappear inside the tile; each shows the same base and height
